Name: Dryads of the Valley for Content Patcher
Author: breeshlean
Description:
[u][b]DESCRIPTION
[/b][/u]
Updated for SDV 1.6

This is a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11805]Dryads of the Valley for Alternative Textures[/url].  Each tree variety can be customized through the config file or through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url].


[u][b]INITIAL USE

[/b][/u]1) This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher.[/url]  Install these first.

2) Unzip this mod's files into the Mods folder. 

[u][b]UPDATES

[/b][/u]When updating this mod, delete the previous version from your Mods folder and drop in the new version.

[u][b]COMPATIBILITY
[/b][/u]
Other mods that alter fruit trees may override this mod or vice versa.  Otherwise, I have found no compatibility issues.
